item.text:
Closing addition executed, and the audit is at its end state.

**Last check added (and passing).** The StopSign boundary probe now also verifies that a freshly started actor on an *already decided* log emits no `Decided` event — the event is documented as "the decided index advanced" — reports `decided_idx() == 4`, and emits exactly one `Reconfigured`. It passes, so restoring an actor doesn't fabricate backlog events; `--all-features` still builds.

**Final state of the audit** — [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-16_23-10-28-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md) (1007 lines), [repro.sh](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-16_23-10-28-omnipaxos-baseline/work/repro.sh) (one command, ~15 s, reproduces every documented outcome), five audit test files, four diagnostic copies (three instrumented), 64 logs:

- **Finding 1** (confirmed): `append_notify` can resolve with a different entry's log index — before its own entry is even accepted. Six repro tests, a 63–75/120 random-workload soak, two controls; a candidate fix queues a placeholder for the call's own advance and takes the file to 8/8 while leaving the captured runtime suite at 24/24.
- **Finding 2** (confirmed): subscriptions starting below `compacted_idx` re-deliver the collapsed prefix every tick and re-deliver decided entries. Two repros; the cursor fix (position, not item count) takes them to 2/2, coexists with finding 1's fix, and keeps the captured suite green.
- **Finding 3** (narrowed, not claimed as a defect): the lagging-follower probe is deterministic, but its filter drops every accept *and* the retry, so it models a dead link — my leader-side fix attempt was refuted by execution, and I recorded that plus the useful `handle_acceptsync`-only-in-`Phase::Prepare` no-op. The re-sent StopSign `Decide` reusing an already-consumed counter is source-confirmed and trace-observed; the captured-suite stalls are documented as slow recovery, not this strand.
- **Negative results**: the four `#[ignore]`d crash-recovery tests pass when run; two stale-leader adoption probes; a 4000-round partition/leader-churn safety soak; the StopSign boundary (now including the event check); load-stability of the captured runtime suite; unicache and workspace sweeps.
- **Honest gaps**: the prepared-but-unexecuted RocksDB storage probe (gated so it can't break other builds, with the one-command recipe and the reason it didn't fit), the durability consequence of finding 1, and the experiment that would settle finding 3.
- **Integrity**: `omnipaxos/src`, `omnipaxos_runtime/src`, `omnipaxos_storage/src` remain byte-identical to the read-only source; only the report, driver, audit tests, instrumented copies and logs were added.
